verdict.rationale: The tools docs say developers can 'call external APIs or lookup data for RAG' through LLM tool use. That makes grounding possible, but the developer has to build retrieval as a custom tool. Nothing in the evidence shows a built-in knowledge base, document ingestion, or vector store. missing for 10: built-in knowledge base/document upload, managed indexing or retrieval, dedicated RAG docs or examples, independent or hands-on corroboration of RAG grounding.
